encoding: UTF-8 CSV/JSON/text; no NaN or Infinity, duplicate JSON keys/CSV headers/identities, symlinks or special files. CSV must have consistent row width.

csv.rows: Exactly the full literal1035 released FILE_ID cohort; order arbitrary. Extra descriptive columns allowed.
csv.null: Empty cell only for nullable values; site_id blank if unavailable. No string null/NaN sentinel.
csv.booleans: true/false or1/0, case-insensitive for true/false; not a numeric substitute in other fields.
csv.metadata_binding: Normalized covariates and statuses from original phenotype; counts/status from original ROI primitive. Eligibility/base_reason from the numerical kernel. Source structural and metadata receipts never determine downstream arithmetic.

primary.mapping: These scientific fields are the named public analyze() return values; pooled and within units participants, between unit sites.
primary.support: age_support and connectivity_support require only Boolean active. Numeric norm/threshold diagnostics may be included but are non-scoring.

sensitivity.quadratic_conditional: linear_residual_support.active and full_residual_support.active required exactly when the public kernel emits those support records. added_norm/added_cutoff/added_basis_orthogonality are optional non-scoring diagnostics, not extra acceptance gates.
sensitivity.per_site: Every eligible site row: association required fields plus site_id,slope,slope_status. Keep undefined rows. Summary requires complete support; exact sign counts use own unrounded replay, not rounded reported r.

metadata.source_files: Every full source-manifest file row keyed by literal path; original values exact, benign added keys allowed. A source inventory is not a derived answer bank.

phenotype_ledger.values: Use original source row index zero-based excluding header; source_availability released_filename/no_filename; source_path ROI path/null. Preserve source SUB_ID token as well as normalized decimal subject_id string.

source_observed.persons: Dictionary keyed by exact FILE_ID. Each contains n_frames,n_columns,header_sha256,all_finite,active_columns,exact_constant_columns,n_active_columns,n_edges. active_columns is200 Booleans in original column order; exact_constant_columns is the set of one-based IDs. All 200 original source_column_ids and phenotype_columns preserve axis order.

metadata.software: Nonempty real version strings for python,numpy,scipy. No exact version or prose fingerprint is a correctness target.

typing.integer: Finite integer-valued numeric JSON/CSV values required for count/rank/df/index/code fields, never Boolean-as-number. JSON3.0 is a valid integer receipt.
typing.continuous: Finite numeric JSON values, never strings or Boolean. Null only where canonical source support or declared inference says undefined.
typing.strict_domains: r, min_r, max_r, median_within_site_r and CI bounds within[-1,1]; probabilities and positive-site fraction within[0,1]; F and sums of squares>=0. CI lower<=upper. Source normalized physical domains hold independently of tolerance.
typing.tolerances: Participant and derived continuous atol1e-6,rtol1e-6; phenotype receipt atol1e-10,rtol1e-9; other discrete/identity/status fields exact. Participant values also obey every public centered/projected relative-fidelity check. Only serialized participant connectivity has the documented outward-cap allowance.
typing.arrays: ids and eligible_site_ids are unique exact memberships with arbitrary ordering. source_files keyed path; phenotype_ledger keyed row index; site_means and per_site keyed site_id. column_ids/source_column_ids/phenotype_columns/active_columns/CI preserve order. exact_constant_columns is an exact unique integer set.
typing.extras: Benign extra JSON keys, CSV columns and optional diagnostics allowed within caps. No unknown extra member in an identity/membership set or keyed record list.

findings: Nonempty bounded interpretation. No mandatory number, keyword, direction or phrase. Automated scoring checks source-bound machine-readable measurements; human review is required for the scientific quality of prose.
failure: A failure_report.json entry (including empty or dangling symlink) before or after reading/validation is authoritative and forces reward0. Original input failures should create status failed_precondition with a nonempty reason and exit nonzero. Never score stale outputs after failure.
scoring: All-or-nothing: reward1 only if all production source-bound and manufactured contract tests pass, otherwise0. No proportional/partial credit claim.
authority: Source reconstruction determines samples, covariates, column support, activity, rank and df. The accepted connectivity.csv values are the sole downstream estimate authority after source-closeness and fidelity checks. No hidden canonical r/p/F/sign/ordering target; reported intermediate outputs are receipts.
